comments.author: @LeslieSox
comments.text: I worked as a manufacturing technician and in R&D. These anecdotes are what the designers and engineers need to receive as feedback on their work. The problem is that the engineers are already onto a new design by the time it is manufactured, and the VPs are onto new projects and don't want to hear about it. What is needed is good QC, quality control engineers in manufacturing who can track parts failures and communicate the quality problems directly to the suppliers and to the engineers. In my experience if most of the products work as designed and are reliable, the designer is going to blame manufacturing or the supplier. They are not going to redesign or recall a complete product line if statistically a very small amount have failures that are caused by parts suppliers or factory workers.
